integrity: The primary manuscript was inspected through the radial norm identity, Schwarz-Pick coefficient estimate, moment-duality theorem, non-increasing-weight sharp-radius construction, and standard-Fock equality proof. The new argument propagates equality through the source moment chain, uses Schwarz-Pick rigidity, and then proves linearity by an exact radial coefficient identity plus strict covariance. No numerical computation is required.
scientific_limitations: The equality classification is proved for Hilbert Fock-type spaces with non-increasing radial weights at their sharp Korenblum radius. It does not treat arbitrary radial weights whose optimal radius is unknown, p different from 2, or quantitative stability of near-extremizers.
title: Universal extremal rigidity for monotone weighted Fock Korenblum radii
